name: Devon Akins
headline: Founder / Software Systems Builder
summary: Founder of ANEVUM, building and operating a multi-service software and research platform spanning orchestration, market systems, forecasting research, mathematical validation, replay, telemetry, evidence pipelines, and production infrastructure. Current work combines React and TypeScript applications with Python services, PostgreSQL/Supabase data systems, containerized deployment, CI/CD, observability, and research-to-production controls.

bullets: Architecting and deploying a multi-service software and research platform with public and protected operational surfaces.
Building React and TypeScript web applications and Python/FastAPI backend services.
Designing PostgreSQL/Supabase telemetry, canonical event, evidence, reconciliation, and research pipelines.
Operating containerized services on Railway and Cloudflare with GitHub Actions verification and deployment workflows.
Building live market-data, execution, risk-control, performance, forecasting, simulation, replay, and research tooling.
Maintaining explicit separation between live execution, shadow research, replay/simulation, and post-event evidence.

education.detail: Relevant coursework: Calculus II, Calculus III, Linear Algebra.
